name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Holds.write
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} {rep : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Rep α},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.GoodRep rep →
    ∀ {T : Nat} {a : α} {lo : Nat} {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Holds rep T a lo m →
        ∀ (x v : Nat),
          LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN →
            Ne.{1} x T →
              Ne.{1} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP →
                DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Holds rep T a lo (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem.write m x v)

source.code:
theorem Holds.write {α : Type} {rep : Rep α} (hr : GoodRep rep) {T : ℕ} {a : α} {lo : ℕ} {m : Mem}
    (h : Holds rep T a lo m) (x v : ℕ) (hx : x < IN) (hxT : x ≠ T) (hx0 : x ≠ HP) :
    Holds rep T a lo (m.write x v) := by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hi, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hlo, hi, h1, by rw [Mem.write_ne _ _ (Ne.symm hx0)]; exact h2, ?_⟩
  rw [Mem.write_ne _ _ (Ne.symm hxT)]
  exact hr.frame m _ lo hi _ _ h3 (fun y hy1 hy2 => Mem.write_ne _ _ (by omega))
